correction: A held delete let go after 10 s while the list still showed the stale row, and an error in the read after a successful delete let go of it too, so a repeated Delete erased the message from Trash. A hold now lasts until the list drops the row, shows it in other mailboxes, or a view opened since shows it; it lets go at once only when nothing was sent or maild still holds the message where the row shows it, and a delete that failed or was not read back stays held.
